description: Issue #830: neutralizes DeletedFile's IsKnownConnectionKey guard condition with a compile-preserving operator (`&& false`, not a deletion) so it can never reject a request, reproducing the pre-fix state where csName flowed straight into Wtm.CreateDC(cskey:) with zero validation. Checked against FileApiControllerHardeningTests830.DeletedFile_UnknownCsName_RejectedWithGuardMessage_KnownCsNameSucceeds, which asserts BOTH the status code (400) AND that the response body contains the guard's own message text ('Unknown connection string key') -- not status-code-only. This distinction matters: 'EVIL_LATERAL_DB' is not a real configured connection either way, so with the guard neutralized the request does not simply succeed -- it falls through and fails downstream for an unrelated reason, which a status-code-only assertion could not distinguish from a genuine guard rejection (the exact tautology #837 already found twice in MvcAuthHolesTests' GetPagingData/GetExportExcel csKey tests). Confirmed empirically: with the guard neutralized the request instead returns 200 (DeletedFile always returns Ok(true)), which is what this mutant's red assertion actually observes.

red_expected_assertion_patterns.WalkingTec.Mvvm.Api.Test.FileApiControll: #830: DeletedFile must reject an unrecognised csName\. Got 200

red_expected_assertion_patterns_observed: Captured against a clean checkout (stale demo.db under bin/ removed first) with the mutant patch applied: 'Assert.AreEqual failed. Expected:<BadRequest>. Actual:<OK>. #830: DeletedFile must reject an unrecognised csName. Got 200: true'
